omx-panel

Panels for audio plugins, generated from what the plugin declares. Give any LV2 or CLAP plugin a panel without drawing one: a MOD GUI for MOD and Zynthian, pages for a controller, a layout for a host, all from the plugin's own declaration, in the omx look, vintage or modern.

omx-modgui-sync gives a generated MOD GUI to every installed LV2 plugin that ships none, and omx-complement-sync carries the port groups an LV2 plugin lacks to lilv, for jalv on the Zynthian touchscreen. Neither touches an installed bundle.

Install

Fedora 44, x86_64 or aarch64:

sudo dnf install https://www.openmixer.org/rpm/openmixer-release.noarch.rpm
sudo dnf install omx-panel

Debian bookworm and trixie, amd64 or arm64 (also Raspberry Pi OS and Zynthian):

cd /tmp && curl -fsSLO https://www.openmixer.org/deb/openmixer-release.deb && sudo apt install ./openmixer-release.deb
sudo apt update && sudo apt install omx-panel

Also on npm: npm install @openmixer/omx-panel.

Start

omx-modgui-sync                                   # a MOD GUI for every installed LV2 plugin without one
sudo systemctl enable omx-modgui-sync             # and again after each plugin-qualify-sync scan
omx-panel modgui --descriptor <file> --out <bundle.lv2>
